title: Initialize the AI Engineering repository and root controls
notes: Grouped because the initial placeholder and root-document bootstrap form one repository-initialization objective. Git timestamps are observed; no original ROS work item or test record was found.

title: Import and normalize the bootstrap, handbook, course, and knowledge-platform corpus
notes: The import audit documents 50 sources, dispositions, hashes, path normalization, and limitations. The final cleanup commit removed leftover nested placeholders. No repository-specific validator existed; the audit explicitly limits its validation claims.

title: Execute the AI research mission and establish evaluation Cycle 001
researchConclusion: The repository selected long-horizon agent evaluation and verification as the highest-value research mission; Cycle 001 established constructs, candidate tasks, registries, and an audit-first sequence without claiming agent capability.
notes: The merge commit is retained for commit lineage but is not treated as independent evidence. Existing records provide the conclusion and limitations; no independent review or capability baseline was claimed.

title: Run evaluation integrity pilots, calibrate graders, and establish the research frontier
researchConclusion: Cycles 002 and 003 produced provisional task-integrity pilots and a 7/7 in-sample deterministic calibration, while the frontier consolidated 23 candidates into 10 open RFRs; independent review, unseen outcomes, and capability trials remained unresolved.
notes: One large commit contains three related but distinguishable repository outcomes. They remain grouped because the commit and state records present them as one evaluation-roadmap update; the index preserves each decision and limitation separately. RP-RFA-2026-001 applies to the frontier subset.

title: Implement stable-identifier, link, and frontier integrity validation
researchConclusion: The first RFR-009 validation slice found no unexplained identifier collisions, broken explicit local Markdown links, or frontier structural mismatches in its declared scope; full metadata and semantic provenance validation remained out of scope.
notes: The decision record states four seeded tests passed on 2026-07-30. That historical result is recorded as reported evidence, not rerun evidence from this migration.

title: Install and configure Research Publisher and GitHub Pages deployment
notes: Generated publisher and dist outputs are secondary build artifacts, not independent evidence. The commits establish configuration and workflow presence; no first successful remote GitHub Pages deployment record was found.

title: Develop the state-constrained architecture research corpus
researchConclusion: The corpus developed a 12-mission research series, synthesis, architecture proposals, experiments, and Time Entry inputs. Most claims are literature, design, or proposed-experiment outputs rather than independently replicated empirical findings.
notes: Current paths reflect the later compatibility-preserving organization. The merge commit is lineage only, and generated publisher files introduced by the merge are not counted as research evidence. Confidence is medium because commit messages are terse and the corpus lacks one historical execution record covering all included documents.

title: Canonicalize the state-constrained corpus and extend metadata diagnostics
researchConclusion: The migration separated reusable research, generic semantic-control architecture, and Time Entry inputs; retained 52 unique artifacts from 54 source files; and extended RFR-009 metadata and relationship diagnostics without imposing strict migration.
notes: The organization audit explicitly preserves findings and provenance, consolidates only two byte-identical duplicates, and records that no commit occurred during the original organization session; the listed commits subsequently captured that work and rebuilt publisher output.
